office_does: Hears and decides misdemeanor cases for the City of Seattle for a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Seattle Municipal Court Presiding Judge Anita Crawford-Willis, on the court since 2017, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Presiding Judge of Seattle Municipal Court, on the court since 2017; previously a public defender, administrative law judge, and pro tem judge.
highlights: Appointed in 2017; re-elected in 2018 and 2022; current Presiding Judge [S1][S2]
About 30 years as a public defender, Administrative Law Judge, and pro tem judge before appointment [S1][S2]
Says she is helping launch Connection Court and expand the Community Resource Center [S1]
